sentences.en: Which will he choose, I wonder, martial arts or death?
sentences.zh: 他到底会选择武艺还是死亡呢？

sentences.en: Countervailing opinions have sadly prevented me from instituting martial law.
sentences.zh: 遗憾的是，反对意见阻止了我宣布军事戒严。

sentences.en: The President suspended the constitution and imposed martial law.
sentences.zh: 总统暂停宪法并实施军事戒严。

senses.zh: 军事的,战争的,尚武的，好战的,战神玛尔斯的
